name: smokeyp-codebase-mapper
description: Scan any repository and produce a polished HTML/PDF architecture report. Four print-first static diagrams: a Bertin module-dependency matrix, a C4 service-topology graph, a critical-paths swimlane, and a Sankey data-lineage view — each with data-derived architect observations and supporting small-multiples. Monorepo-aware module detection, broad HTTP framework coverage (NestJS, Express, FastAPI, Flask, Django, Rails, Spring Boot, Laravel, Go, Next.js), import parsing across Python/JS/TS/Go/Elixir (incl. workspace packages), ORM-driven data store mapping (Prisma, SQLAlchemy, Mongoose, Django ORM, ActiveRecord, JPA), and beginner-friendly explainers throughout. An on-by-default LLM evaluation pass adds a code-derived overview, product-vs-vendored classification, and cited execution-flow diagrams (use --no-llm to skip); module-graph edges are extracted with tree-sitter accuracy when the ast-grep binary is present (automatic, with full regex fallback). If the scanned repo already has a grepai semantic index (from the user's own grepai daemon), the evaluator uses it to ground findings; building an index is opt-in via --semantic. Self-contained core (Python stdlib only; ast-grep and grepai are optional accelerators), no JavaScript runtime. Styled with the SmokeyP editorial design system.
